messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detecting spike in billing emitter lag for token counts. metric=token_emit_lag > 5m for 00:10 window. Severity: P1. Auto-pager to #incidents and oncall.

oncall-ops: I'm on pager, grabbing context. Any customer impact reported?

cs-ledger: we've got 3 incoming tickets in the last 8min complaining about 'unexpected overage' emails. Customer IDs listed in ticket queue.

sam: looking at emitter logs now. Observed broker consumer falling behind on partition 12. tail of /var/log/emitter.log:
```
WARN consumer lag=12345 partition=12 fetch_ms=8000
ERROR commit failed: Timeout
```

lee: are counts missing or delayed? That distinction matters for overage flags.

maya: aggregation shows live_stream_tokens in ingest pipeline is ~30% lower than billing aggregate for the last hour, then backlog spike when consumer recovered. So delayed ingestion, then backfill caused sudden high deltas triggering overage rules.

billing-eng: confirmed. Rule engine triggered on the backfill burst. We need to suppress alerts while we mitigate and backfill gracefully.

oncall-ops: action plan: 1) restart consumer on partition 12 (sam) 2) throttle backfill so alerts don't fire (billing-eng) 3) open short-term suppress on overage notifications (cs-ledger). Executing now.

sam: restarting consumer pod k8s/emitter-consumer-12 -> kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter-consumer -n prod

infra-bot: Restart initiated by sam at 2026-03-17T12:34:55Z, pod restart id emitter-consumer-12-rc5

sam: consumer back to steady state, lag dropping to <500 in 2min.

billing-eng: pausing overage rule evals for 20m: set config alerts.overage.enabled=false; will re-enable after throttled backfill completes. :white_check_mark:

cs-ledger: suppression applied and CS notified to hold outgoing emails for affected customers. Sending templated note to open tickets.

maya: launching controlled backfill with rate_limit=1000 tokens/sec. Monitoring delta. Query:
```
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens) FROM billing.live_tokens WHERE partition=12 AND ts > now()-2h GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;
```

lee: seeing counts converge. No new overage triggers after suppression. Good.

billing-eng: root cause: consumer transient timeout + partition imbalance causing delayed commits -> backfill burst triggered alert rules. Long term: add consumer autoscaling, increase commit retries, and rate-limit backfill bursts.

oncall-ops: handing off to night oncall lee for monitoring. Leaving ticket notes and runbook updates. :handshake:

lee: I'll monitor metrics for next 3 hours, will reopen if anything flaps. Thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: status=mitigated, mitigation=consumer_restart+backfill_throttle+alert_suppress, closed_by=oncall-ops, closed_ts=3952467965
